title: Keep approve refusal hints to drafts, cover the scope questions, show single-choice placeholders, and commit the Quick Start source (#917)
description: Keep approve refusal hints to drafts, cover the scope questions, show single-choice placeholders, and commit the Quick Start source (#917)
acceptance_criteria: A draft without an affected path is refused with `specsync change answer <id> affected_paths "<path>"` named, and a draft without an affected spec (and no justified no-spec change) with `specsync change answer <id> affected_specs "<module>"`; running them moves approval on (REQ-change-133, DOCS-3.a).

An approved, implementing or verifying record that fails the same definition checks is refused with the same condition text and no `change answer` command, because that command refuses outside draft (REQ-change-133).

The unfinished-interview refusal shows the first question choices as the placeholder whenever it has any (`<yes|no>`, `<none>` for constraints) and `"<answer>"` only when it has none, as REQ-change-133 says.
The approval guard refuses exactly the definitions it refused before; only refusal text changes.

The landing page Quick Start commits the files it created before the first change, so following it as written leaves a clean tree when the reader pushes; landing_page_change_workflow_runs_from_its_quick_start starts from exactly the documented state with no harness commit (DOCS-1).
The new unit tests and the two changed integration tests fail at 2b30841d and pass after the change; the README and the other landing-page tests keep passing.

answers.constraints: specs/change/change.3md: refusal reasons name the concrete remediation while the predicates stay unchanged (the stale accepted-change reasons precedent, and the z=15 #883 lesson); a remediation must be runnable in the record's state, so change answer is named only for drafts; read-only text views keep their generic diagnostic. No principles file is configured.
